frame: FTC field frame, inches: origin at the field center on the tiles, +x toward the audience, +y from the red wall toward the blue wall, z up. Heading counter-clockwise from +x seen from above.
accuracyNote: Tag numbers are copied exactly from the FTC SDK. The goals, obelisk and other field elements are not drawn yet: add them from the DECODE Competition Manual or field CAD (don't guess them).
